## Description

Create `tests/agents/test-verification-evidence-emission.sh` with 10 test functions, one per code-reviewer agent. Each test checks that the agent file contains `verification_evidence` in its finding format schema. Tests are in RED state — they fail before T2 adds the field to the agent files.

Also update `.test-index` to add RED markers linking each of the 10 code-reviewer-*.md files to this test file.

## Done Definitions

- `tests/agents/test-verification-evidence-emission.sh` exists and is executable
- File contains exactly 10 test functions: `test_code_reviewer_{light,standard,performance,deep_arch,deep_correctness,deep_hygiene,deep_verification,security_red_team,security_blue_team,test_quality}_emits_verification_evidence`
- Each test function greps the corresponding agent file for `verification_evidence` and FAILS (since agents don't have the field yet) — confirming RED state
- Each test embeds a distinct absence-claim diff fixture (different pattern per agent) as documentation of the triggering scenario
- `.test-index` has entries for all 10 code-reviewer-*.md files pointing to `tests/agents/test-verification-evidence-emission.sh`
- Running the test file exits non-zero (RED)

## ## File Impact

- `tests/agents/test-verification-evidence-emission.sh` — NEW, executable
- `.test-index` — UPDATED (10 new entries)

## Testing Mode

RED — tests intentionally fail before T2 implementation

## Implementation Notes

Test pattern (follows tests/hooks/test-agent-standard-reference.sh):
```bash
test_code_reviewer_light_emits_verification_evidence() {
    # Fixture: diff where reviewer claims "no error handler found"
    local agent_file="$PLUGIN_ROOT/plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-light.md"
    grep -q "verification_evidence" "$agent_file"
    assert_eq "test_code_reviewer_light: verification_evidence in schema" "0" "$?"
}
```

Each test function uses a distinct absence-claim phrase as its fixture comment:
- light: "no error handler found"
- standard: "missing null check"
- performance: "no index exists"
- deep-arch: "pattern not implemented"
- deep-correctness: "value is absent"
- deep-hygiene: "never defined"
- deep-verification: "does not exist"
- security-red-team: "no validation present"
- security-blue-team: "lacks sanitization"
- test-quality: "untested path"

.test-index entries to add (format: `source_file:test_file`):
```
plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-light.md:tests/agents/test-verification-evidence-emission.sh
plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-standard.md:tests/agents/test-verification-evidence-emission.sh
plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-performance.md:tests/agents/test-verification-evidence-emission.sh
plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-deep-arch.md:tests/agents/test-verification-evidence-emission.sh
plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-deep-correctness.md:tests/agents/test-verification-evidence-emission.sh
plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-deep-hygiene.md:tests/agents/test-verification-evidence-emission.sh
plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-deep-verification.md:tests/agents/test-verification-evidence-emission.sh
plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-security-red-team.md:tests/agents/test-verification-evidence-emission.sh
plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-security-blue-team.md:tests/agents/test-verification-evidence-emission.sh
plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-test-quality.md:tests/agents/test-verification-evidence-emission.sh
```

Note: code-reviewer-arbiter.md is NOT in scope for S2 (not in the story's list of 10).
